fact: Data Protection Act 2024 (Act No. 18 of 2024), gazetted 29 October 2024, s.74 requires that any transfer of personal data to a third country be made on condition that a copy of the data remains in Botswana for the period of processing, with the Information and Data Protection Commission as supervisory authority (ss.12-16).
title: Data Protection Act, 2024 (Government Gazette, Extraordinary)
